name: TOP_TARGETPAIRS_BY_PATENT_COUNT
description: Top target pairs ranked by total patent count. Non-standard entries without a target-pair separator are excluded from this ranking.
cypher:
MATCH (tp:TargetPair)<-[:HAS_TARGET_PAIR]-(p:Patent)
WHERE tp.name CONTAINS '/'
RETURN tp.name AS target_pair, count(DISTINCT p) AS patent_count
ORDER BY patent_count DESC, target_pair
LIMIT 10;
